title: Choose TradePilot's visual world
question: The roll assigned Morning Briefing Packet. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Morning Briefing Packet
options.lineage: executive desk briefing memos and priority packets
options.thesis: Your markets arrive as a morning briefing: what needs attention first, then your watchlist, then the wider market.
options.viewport: Desktop home as one vertical briefing: quiet TradePilot chrome, session masthead, Needs attention stratum, struck watchlist quotes as the personal core, quieter global market context below — no interchangeable widget card grid.
options.risk: Can feel corporate-generic if strata become boxed cards instead of a continuous packet.

raised.raise: Focus-expansion: the attended symbol or alert gains presence while neighbors quietly recede.
Accent thrift: one action accent appears sparingly across a viewport, not as scattered decoration.
Strata voids: deep intentional gaps separate briefing layers instead of equal card gutters.
Struck selection: active rows snap forward without boxing every cell in chrome.
Measurement grid: prices and deltas sit on a shared tabular alignment, not free-floating chips.

options.label: Morning Broadsheet
options.thesis: TradePilot as your personal markets section: columns of type and numbers you read, not a dashboard you operate.
options.viewport: Full-width masthead with TradePilot wordmark as section title, then a lead watchlist column beside a quieter market-context column — hierarchy from type weight, not cards.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on; can tip into broadsheet costume if hairlines and serifs become the whole idea.

options.label: Session Cyclorama
options.thesis: Market session as atmosphere: the shell's horizon light marks pre-market, open, and close while your watchlist stays the actors on stage.
options.viewport: Dark-to-light horizon band behind a sparse shell; watchlist and alerts hold as horizontal bands stacked from attention to context, with session phase labeled in text.
options.case: Wins morning-ritual identification; loses on product clarity for tables, quotes, and alerts that need a paper-calm reading surface.
options.risk: Atmosphere can overpower scanability if color becomes the only session signal.

options.label: Watchlist Title Wall
options.case: Entertainment browsing grammar fights morning quote scanning and tabular market work.
options.kept: Focus-expansion: one attended item grows while the rest quiet.

options.label: Monochrome Proof Desk
options.case: Claim-and-proof marketing topology is Persuade grammar, not a daily Operate workspace.
options.kept: Accent thrift across the whole shell.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Surreal construction may dazzle but fails investor identification and market-task clarity.
options.kept: Strata voids — deep gaps between information layers.

options.label: Struck Cathode Gauze
options.case: Night-instrument neon edges toward terminal intimidation the brief rejects.
options.kept: Struck selection without boxing every value.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.case: Lab-instrument metaphor collapses into trading-terminal and crypto aesthetics.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished dark retail-investing dashboard: sticky chrome, interchangeable rounded widget cards, green/red deltas, chart-forward home.
canonCard.viewport: Header plus a grid of market overview, heatmap, news, and quotes cards — the incumbent arrangement executed at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other retail finance template by design.
